opportunities.title: Research Awards (including named awards such as Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright, Open Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; early‑career researchers are encouraged; work must not be for an undergraduate or postgraduate degree and must not be a retrospective application.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support research into the material past through archaeology, art history, architectural history, material culture, collections and related fields. Projects may include travel & subsistence, specialist investigation, equipment hire, and consumables.

opportunities.title: William Lambarde Travel Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; primarily for research travel costs; early‑career researchers are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Travel award for researchers to fund travel and subsistence related to projects funded by the Society’s Research Grants scheme.

opportunities.title: William & Jane Morris Church Conservation Grant – August round
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants proposing conservation projects for churches; details of eligibility are provided in the application guidelines.
opportunities.summary: Grant to support conservation work on churches, with two application rounds each year.
